gate: M10/1 Active; all-variant metadata and authored File membership delivered; complete common-codec acceptance open
deliverable: Video duration discovery includes authored variants without render consumers. Desktop and headless hosts retain one bounded metadata IO service independently of renderer/device creation. Real File edits, clears, channel removal, reparenting, history and project activation update the same media control; consumer withdrawal preserves timing.

ownership.golden: A demux-only timing probe exposes original stream units without retaining a frame decoder. ProcessCtx::register_ancestor_runtime settles read-only runtime-handle registrations synchronously, including history-ready callbacks and project activation. ProcessCtx::is_destroying exposes the known teardown batch without a whole-tree snapshot.
ownership.app: Channel registrations bind the actual typed File to a media control. A counted ordered duration set updates the longest known duration in logarithmic time. The project-scoped weak registry avoids document scans and does not keep metadata IO alive merely because Undo retains a removed node. Already-admitted Matrix clip producers retain a retired media control and its Files until final use.
ownership.recovery: Missing endpoints retry at one second while preserving known timing. Authored relink/clear/removal revoke old File generations; stale publications reject. Relative-root changes re-probe resolved paths. Project and File-generation guards cancel obsolete demux probes. Filesystem checks, probing and waits run on the IO worker, never the engine/UI.
ownership.bounds: Metadata service lifetime admission has two slots including retirement, registry4096 media owners, per-media4096 authored channels and project4096 configured metadata Files. Existing eight decode-worker slots and768 MiB admitted image/worker storage remain unchanged. No hard cap on every FFmpeg temporary allocation is claimed.
ownership.seeks: Saved seeks clamped by partial metadata become eligible as longer variants arrive. Clearing all timing preserves the authored seek for replacement metadata. Repeating an explicit seek reapplies its runtime action even if the Parameter already has that value. No metadata observation creates authored history.

software.core_lifecycle: Final destroy_scope and lifecycle integration suites pass1+5 tests, including synchronous read-only ancestor registration after Undo and snapshot-free child-versus-parent teardown through Undo/Redo.
software.strict: Combined MapGyver/golden_video/golden_engine --lib --tests Clippy with video-files/ffmpeg/qualification and -D warnings exits0. Feature-disabled MapGyver --lib --tests strict Clippy also exits0.
software.final_affected_check: Final Video-filtered suite passes29 tests, exit0, after explicit registration release on reparent/history rebind. This includes transport, metadata, scripts and real file/retained-frame integration. Final native-host session guard ordering is compiled by strict lint; no new desktop visual claim.
software.coverage: Real common-codec timing units, unopened longer variants, partial-metadata seek recovery, authored clears, stale generations, generic File Parameters, sparse live activation, history/removal/reparenting, relative-root relocation, endpoint loss/relink/retry and authoritative headless service retirement. A real looping Video copied into a Matrix Cell keeps changing decoded pixels after authored replacement, then withdraws and retires all workers/retained image bytes when playback releases it. Existing generated-contract equality passes in the full app suite.
software.ui: No UI or wire-contract changes in this slice. The prior exact-step milestone's zero-error/warning UI check and two background-query/activity tests remain applicable. Both root and golden_core formatters run.

repairs_during_validation: The initial combined command omitted Golden's qualification feature required by existing native test helpers. Tests exposed overly broad manager invalidation from deep registration events, repeated-seek and duration-clear intent loss, channel membership retained by Undo-owned node payloads, and startup registration events discarded by bootstrap inbox cleanup. The final implementation removes event-based registration entirely in favor of the read-only ancestor hook, revokes membership explicitly during destroy and uses the known teardown scope to preserve retired clip producers. The reload fixture also now follows Golden's real runtime activation path. Initial Core integration fixture assumptions about add_node's return value and EngineTime defaults were corrected. Earlier failed runs are not counted as passes.
native: No new native or desktop experiment. Existing both-GPU source/upload/alpha/pixel proofs retain their original scope. This slice's Matrix proof covers the actual retained producer graph and live decoded frame stream with the Null renderer; it is not actual-app visual, hardware-decode or sustained performance acceptance.
remaining: Deliver source diagnostics and actual-app panel/Screen common-codec playback checks, remaining profile/color/alpha coverage, GPU-resident hardware decode and default integration. Then complete HAP and bundled first-pass recovery, DLL/license/source redistribution and sustained1080p/4K/resource/seek checks before M14. DXV/WebP follows M14. No whole M10 gate closes in this slice.
